title: Gaussian Approximation for Composition and Subsampling of Differentially Private Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.33333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The privacy analysis of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) relies on bounds for the composition of subsampled mechanisms. The privacy of such a composition is bounded by that of a pair of product distributions, whose privacy loss is a sum of independent terms and has been analyzed via a variety of notions and concentration results. Yet, existing closed-form bounds either lose a logarithmic factor or require restrictive conditions on the noise scale and delicate analysis of subsampling. Further, while it is well known that sums of independent random variables are approximately Gaussian, existing CLT-based techniques give an approximation with a large error in $\delta$.   We show that the privacy loss of this pair is approximately Gaussian as long as each step has a small privacy loss except with small probability. translated_title: 差分隐私算法组合与子采样的高斯近似
translated_abstract: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）的隐私分析依赖于子采样机制组合的界限。这种组合的隐私性由一对乘积分布的隐私性所界定，其隐私损失是独立项之和，已通过多种概念和集中性结果进行了分析。然而，现有的闭式界限要么损失一个对数因子，要么对噪声尺度施加限制性条件，并需要对子采样进行精细分析。此外，尽管理论上众所周知独立随机变量之和近似服从高斯分布，但现有的基于中心极限定理（CLT）的技术给出的近似在 $\delta$ 上存在较大误差。我们证明，只要每一步在除小概率情形外都具有较小的隐私损失，这对分布的隐私损失就近似服从高斯分布。具体而言，其隐私损失分布接近于一个具有相同均值和方差的高斯分布……
tldr: 该论文证明只要子采样机制组合中每一步的隐私损失在除小概率情形外都很小，其组合的隐私损失分布就近似服从具有相同均值和方差的高斯分布，从而为DP-SGD的隐私分析提供了无需对数因子损失或噪声尺度限制条件的更优界限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the privacy loss distribution of composed subsampled mechanisms is approximately Gaussian with the same mean and variance as long as each step has small privacy loss except with small probability, yielding tighter bounds for DP-SGD privacy analysis without logarithmic losses or restrictive noise conditions.
